page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a running head at the top, a page number at the head right, a catchword at the foot right and a gathering signature at the foot left. No marginal notes; only small printer's marks in the margins.

main_text.p: cabilem, volitiones Dei & mutabiles, & tem-porales, noftrique lubrici & inconftantis arbi-trii paffibus coævas esse, fatis manifefte aftruit. Nam quoties homo credit, eft in Deo decre-tum electionis, quoties eadem horâ diffidit Deo promittenti, facit fe formale reprobatio-nis objectum, & oritur in Deo novum decre-tum reprobationis; rurfus idem credit, poftea non credit, graviter peccat, denuo & refipifcit & credit, en Euripi more, Dei decreta fin-genda, indies mutanda, ad humani arbitrii revolutiones vel currus rotulis mutabiliores; & quis ignorat ecclefiam Pfal. 77. & fanctos, Davidem Pfal. 6. Iobum cap. 2. in eadem ora-tione ad Deum, & triumphos facros agere, & etiam cum Deo, ex carnis prævalentis diffi-dentiâ, expostulare, imo Deum oblivionis, inconstantiæ & mutati propositi, non procul à blasphemiarum aspersione, postulare? An ecclefia eadem horâ etiam inter orandum in chorum electorum cooptatur, denuo & re-probis & tenebrarum Angelis, in Dei volun-tate simplicissima accensetur? Quid hic Armi-niani? Agnoscimus (inquiunt) electionem & reprobationem peremtoriam, ex præscien-tia finalis in fide vel infidelitate perseverantiæ omnium in ecclefia viventium. R. Quorsum ergo illa decantata distinctio, quam in scrip-turis haberi clamitant Arminiani? Quare Deus vitæ adjudicaret, quem juxta præscientiam in-fidelitatis finalis in peccato in spiritum sanctum obstinatione horrendâ moriturum præscit?

page.notes: Printed text runs as one paragraph from the top of the page to its end. Page number reads as "2f" in the scan, which I have taken as 21; it is doubtful. Long s is written as plain s throughout, including in the Psalm references. The left margin shows only a small dot and a mark at the line "Arminiani" and a stroke at the right near "fidelitatis"; these are printer's marks, not text. The gathering signature reads "B 3". The catchword reads "Nom-".
